outcome: Adult offspring's gut microbiota (fecal abundance of Acidaminococcus genus)
Adult offspring's body adiposity (visceral adipose tissue)
cohort: The study included 114 adult women (median age 28 years) from the Nutritionists' Health Study, who had early life and clinical data, body composition, and biological samples collected.
finding: Visceral adipose tissue in adult offspring was significantly correlated with the abundance of Acidaminococcus genus, and in the Blautia-driven gut microbiota profile, this genus also correlated with maternal gestational weight gain.
cross-section timing: When participants were adults (median age 28 years)
